integrity: An elementary exhaustive run-transition case proof for all positive integer parameters is supplied. Finite brute-force verifier corroborates but does not replace the infinite proof. General prior minimal-absent-word algorithms are credited, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Exact contiguous minimal-absent-word theorem for positive-parameter four-run binary words only; arbitrary strings and larger alphabets are outside scope. An unlocated equivalent specialization of general run-length encoded algorithms is possible.
title: Complete antidictionary and a three-valued excess law for four-run binary words
